name: Noro (Working Title)
summary:
Noro is a 2.5D sandbox adventure about a magic academy student trying to restore the constellations to the world. The world is procedurally generated and fully destructible.

Players cast elemental magic, discover new spells, dig for resources, build, and experiment. Spells can be combined and imbued into equipment and objects, giving them uses in combat, exploration, and construction. Rescuing lost teachers and freeing corrupted dragons returns constellations to the sky and increases your magic power.

The game supports solo play, online co-op and couch co-op.
